title: Vibe Coding se Kya Sach Mein App Ban Sakta Hai? | CodeOrCap
description:
Aaj kal har koi bol raha hai — bina coding seekhe app bana diya! Lekin kya Vibe Coding sach mein programming hai, ya ek time bomb?

Hum security, understanding, aur production-readiness ke teen angles se test karte hain — data aata hai Veracode, GitGuardian, Carnegie Mellon, aur USENIX research se. Fair verdict, no vibe.

scenes.text: Aaj kal har koi bol raha hai — 'maine coding seekhe bina ek pura app bana diya.' Welcome to vibe coding — bas AI ko English mein bolo, wo code likh deta hai. Lekin kya ye sach mein programming hai… ya ek time bomb? Code ya Cap?
scenes.imagePrompt: Person speaking confidently to camera, laptop open showing lines of code generated by AI, dark tech studio background with neon glow, dramatic lighting, cinematic frame

scenes.text: Viral claim ye hai: 'Ab programming seekhne ki zaroorat nahi — vibe coding kaafi hai. Bas English mein bolo, AI baaki sab kar dega. Ab koi bhi software bana sakta hai.' Term Andrej Karpathy ne 2025 mein coin kiya, aur 2026 tak 92% developers AI se code likhwa rahe hain. Sunne mein revolution lagta hai. Lekin CodeOrCap pe hum vibe pe nahi — evidence pe chalte hain.
scenes.imagePrompt: Viral social media posts and tweets displayed on floating screens in dark space, glowing text about AI replacing programmers, dramatic neon lighting with skeptical overlay

scenes.text: Rules clear kar dete hain. Hum vibe coding ko teen angle se test karenge — security, understanding, aur production-readiness. Data aayega Veracode, GitGuardian, Carnegie Mellon aur USENIX security research se. Aur haan — hum fair rahenge, vibe coding ke fayde bhi dikhaenge. Let's go.
scenes.imagePrompt: Three glowing pillars labeled Security, Understanding, Production-Readiness in a dark tech arena, dramatic cinematic lighting, data streams flowing in background

scenes.text: Pehle sach ye — vibe coding waqai powerful hai. AI assistants se developers lagbhag 21% fast kaam karte hain. Idea se working prototype ghanton mein ban jaata hai, hafton mein nahi. MVP banana ho, internal tool, ya bas seekhna ho — vibe coding kamaal ka hai. Aur democratization real hai — vibe coding ke 63% users non-developers hain. Jo pehle sirf soch sakte the, ab bana sakte hain. Toh yahan tak — vibe coding ek genuine superpower hai.
scenes.imagePrompt: Upward trending graphs and charts glowing green, diverse people confidently building apps on laptops, success metrics floating in holographic displays, optimistic warm neon lighting

scenes.text: Ab danger — yahi wo hissa hai jo hype chhupata hai. Veracode ne 100 se zyada AI models test kiye: 45% AI-generated code mein OWASP top-10 security holes the. Carnegie Mellon ka data aur darawana — 61% code chalta toh hai, par sirf 10.5% security review paas karta hai. Matlab har 100 mein se 11 se bhi kam snippets safe. GitGuardian kehta hai AI-assisted commits secrets — API keys, passwords — lagbhag do-guna zyada leak karte hain. Aur real incidents? Tea app ne users ke private DMs leak kar diye — ek broken access control ki wajah se. Ek aur vibe-coded app se 1.5 million API keys leak ho gaye, bina ek bhi security review ke. Ye theory nahi — ye ho chuka hai.
scenes.imagePrompt: Red warning alerts and security breach notifications flooding dark screens, cracked code panels with glowing red vulnerabilities exposed, dramatic alarming cyberpunk aesthetic

scenes.text: Toh vibe coding versus asli programming. Vibe coding: fast, sabke liye accessible, prototypes ke liye perfect. Programming: aap samajhte ho code kya kar raha hai — edge cases, security, aur jab cheez toote toh aap fix kar sakte ho. Ek Tenzai study mein Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Devin aur Codex — har ek tool ne SSRF vulnerability introduce ki, aur zero apps mein CSRF protection tha. Difference simple hai: vibe coding code likhta hai. Programming decide karta hai ki wo code sahi hai ya nahi.
scenes.imagePrompt: Split screen comparison — left side glowing blue AI code generation fast and flashy, right side deep focused programmer understanding architecture, dramatic dividing line between them

scenes.text: Ab asli sach. 'Vibe coding is NOT programming' — iska matlab ye nahi ki vibe coding bekaar hai. Matlab ye hai — code generate karna aur software engineer hona, do alag cheezein hain. Programming sirf typing nahi hai — wo judgment hai, understanding hai, responsibility hai. Jab aap wo cheez ship karte ho jo aap khud samajhte nahi — wahi khatarnak hai. Senior engineers ka AI code accuracy pe trust already 40% se girke 29% ho gaya hai. Vibe coding se prototype banao — bilkul banao. Par usse bina samjhe, bina review kiye production mein daalna — that's the danger. Vibe coding ek accelerator hai — autopilot nahi.
scenes.imagePrompt: Thoughtful senior developer reviewing AI-generated code critically, dual screens showing both AI output and careful human review, balanced tension between acceleration and caution, cinematic dark tech lab

scenes.text: Verdict. Claim tha: 'Vibe coding programming ko replace kar deta hai — ab seekhne ki zaroorat nahi.' Truth? Tool khud real aur powerful hai — par ye claim mostly cap hai, aur bina samjhe production mein use karna genuinely dangerous. Vibe coding programming nahi hai — ye programming ke upar ek layer hai. Truth rating: is claim ko das mein se teen.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dramatic verdict reveal — large glowing CAP stamp over the viral claim text, truth meter showing 3 out of 10, dark cinematic courtroom-style lighting with red and yellow accents

scenes.text: Toh AI se code zaroor likhwao — par programming seekhna mat chhodo. Kyunki jo samajhta hai, wahi control karta hai. Ye analysis helpful laga toh subscribe karo — hum guessing nahi, knowing pe kaam karte hain. Milte hain agle fact-check mein. CodeOrCap.
